fallback: Show the cited source and request human verification.
killCriterion: Retire if unsupported claims are marked supported above the site bar.

questions.instructions: Classify the relationship between one atomic claim and captured source text. Preserve evidence that both supports and contradicts it; missing or insufficient source is unknown.

options.name: contradicted
options.criteria: Source directly contradicts claim without support

options.name: mixed
options.criteria: Source contains both direct support and contradiction

options.name: unsupported
options.criteria: Available source neither entails nor contradicts claim
